name: Dylan's Toasted & Roasted Coffee House
signature_dish: Hello to the Queen with Dylan's cookies
why_it_matters: Old Manali's specialty-coffee origin point — opened in 2005 by Raj 'Dylan' Nalwa with two American friends, and the cafe most travellers cite as the moment Manali stopped serving instant Nescafe. House-roasted beans, the dessert 'Hello to the Queen' (banana, cream, biscuit, ice cream) became a regional signature.
insider_tip: Cash-only and tiny — there's a perpetual queue past 11am. Come at 9am for an empty terrace and ask for the day's roast neat, not as a flavoured latte.
signature_address: Near Govt School, Old Manali, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh

name: Drifters' Inn & Cafe
why_it_matters: Manu Temple Road's longest-running cafe-stay combo — sun deck, fireplace lounge, fully stocked bar and themed music nights. Acts as the social anchor for backpackers walking up from the bridge into Old Manali village.
insider_tip: The sun deck warms up by 11am even in shoulder season — much better for breakfast than the indoor bar room which stays cold. Book ahead on weekend nights when there's a live act.
signature_address: Manu Temple Road, Old Manali Village, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh

name: The Lazy Dog
why_it_matters: Old Manali's premium gastro-pub — terraced seating that drops directly to the Manalsu river, full international menu (Thai/Vietnamese/Italian/sushi) and a cocktail bar that runs late. The benchmark when Manali tries to dress up.
insider_tip: The lowest river-deck tables go to whoever's first at the door at 12.30pm; no amount of asking moves you down. Order the tandoori trout — it's their actual signature, not the sushi.
signature_address: Manu Temple Road, Old Manali, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh

name: The Johnson's Cafe
why_it_matters: India's first dedicated trout restaurant — opened in 1997 on the family estate originally built in the early 1900s by Col. C.R. Johnson. The wood-and-stone cottage, garden seating and Saturday-night jazz set the template for old-Anglo Manali dining.
insider_tip: Lunch in the apple-orchard garden is the move; the indoor dining room only earns its place on cold nights. Book a Saturday for the live jazz, but call ahead — they fill out two days ahead in summer.
signature_address: Circuit House Road, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh

name: Mingma's Coffee Shop
why_it_matters: A six-table specialty-coffee and bake counter on Club House Road below Goat Microbrewery — coffee-and-dessert only, no full kitchen. Workation regulars rate it higher than the bigger names because the brews are tighter and the cakes are baked in-house each morning.
insider_tip: It's takeaway-friendly with no real workspace seating — grab the lemon cake and a flat white to-go and walk down to the river. They run out of cakes by mid-afternoon.
signature_address: Club House Road, below Goat Microbrewery, Old Manali, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh
